svg.aria-label: Star chart of GitHub contributions over the last year: 2,102 contributions, one star per day. Brightest star: May 2 with 212 commits. Longest streak: 7 days. Planets mark things I shipped: Janus, Metis, Memoria, Clew Directive, Steep, Themis Lex, Agentis Lux, Verity Lex, Porch Light, Observator, Two Sisters, Dead Keys (in progress). A small scout ship patrols the chart, and each active day flares as it passes.
